name: The Agentic SOC: Autonomous Investigation and Response with Guardrails
description: Design and operate AI agents that investigate and respond in a SOC: autonomy levels, agent architecture and tool design over MCP, investigation planning and evidence handling, bounded response actions with approvals and rollback, evaluation harnesses and red-teaming of the agents themselves, and the operating model changes an agentic SOC requires.
fieldOfStudy: Security by AI: AI for Cyber Defense

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: The Agentic SOC: Autonomous Investigation and Response with Guardrails

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
